skill.name: personwise-product-first-success
skill.description: Build grounded, interactive product quick-start courses from supplied setup guides, manuals, and help articles using the PersonWise course workflow.
skill.summary: Turn verified product materials into an interactive course that guides learners to their first successful use.
skill.author: personwiseai

security_audit.summary: Two hardcoded release URLs are confirmed low-severity supply-chain exposures because the installers download native executables, although approval and pinned hashes provide strong safeguards. Shell substitutions, filesystem operations, reconnaissance labels, Markdown backticks, and signed high-entropy values are false positives in context. The workflow also uploads selected documents and mutates a PersonWise account, creating a medium privacy and authorization risk.

remediation.issue: Selected documents are uploaded to an external PersonWise account.
remediation.suggestion: Before each upload, identify the files, destination service, and purpose, then obtain explicit confirmation that the user accepts external transfer.

remediation.issue: A general course request is treated as approval to consume existing credits.
remediation.suggestion: Show the required credit count and request confirmation immediately before creating each course or broadening its visibility.

remediation.issue: The bootstrap downloads and installs a native executable from the vendor release host.
remediation.suggestion: Publish independently verifiable signed release manifests and require native code-signing validation on supported platforms in addition to pinned hashes.

content.value_statement: New users often stall before reaching a product's first useful result. This skill turns supplied product materials into a grounded, interactive PersonWise quick-start course.
actual_capabilities: Creates evidence-grounded quick-start courses from supplied setup guides, manuals, help articles, images, and selected documents.
Checks PersonWise account readiness and resolves course length against current slide and credit limits.
Uploads user-selected source documents and monitors their processing status before course generation continues.
Reviews outline, script, image, and final checkpoints against factual, visual, and safety requirements.
Resumes interrupted runs and applies bounded retries using current server state and idempotent operations.
Publishes courses privately, by link, or to Topics when the user requests and account state permits.
limitations: Requires PersonWise CLI 1.1.6 or newer, browser OAuth, network access, and available course credits.
Evidence-locked courses can teach only facts supported by the supplied materials.
The course cannot perform, verify, or certify real installation, calibration, safety, or operational work.
High-risk equipment and regulated workflows require confirmation from an on-site or qualified person.

use_cases.title: Launch a Customer Quick Start
use_cases.description: Convert verified setup documentation into a short course that guides new customers to their first successful result.

use_cases.title: Standardize Employee Product Setup
use_cases.description: Create a consistent internal onboarding course from approved manuals, screenshots, and troubleshooting guidance.

use_cases.title: Reduce Early Support Questions
use_cases.description: Build an interactive course that explains documented setup steps and common blockers before users contact support.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Basic Quick Start
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a private first-success course from these supplied setup materials. Guide a new user from signup or unboxing to one verified result.
prompt_templates.scenario: A beginner has approved source materials and needs a simple onboarding course.

prompt_templates.title: Add Troubleshooting Guidance
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a first-success course from these manuals and help articles. Include documented prerequisites, common blockers, fixes, and a final verification step.
prompt_templates.scenario: A support team wants setup guidance with evidence-based troubleshooting.

prompt_templates.title: Design for a Limited Account
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a private quick-start course from these sources. Check account readiness, fit the teaching arc within current limits, and preserve essential setup steps.
prompt_templates.scenario: A course must adapt to live slide and credit constraints.

prompt_templates.title: Create and Publish a Reviewed Course
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a link-access first-success course from these selected documents and images. Review every checkpoint, correct unsupported claims, verify playability, and return the share link.
prompt_templates.scenario: An advanced user requests source upload, detailed review, and final publication.

output_examples.input: Create a private five-slide quick-start course from our approved setup guide.
output: Resolved course: five slides, private access, one selected source.
Teaching arc: outcome, prerequisites, guided setup, documented blockers, and result verification.
Final status: playable private course with a sign-in link.

output_examples.input: Turn our manual and troubleshooting article into a shareable first-success course.
output: Both sources were processed before generation continued.
The outline and script were checked for factual support and repeated content.
Final status: playable link-access course with the returned share link.

output_examples.input: Our account supports fewer slides than requested. Create the strongest course that fits.
output_examples.output: The course was recomposed to the current slide limit while preserving prerequisites, the shortest verified setup path, blocker recovery, and final verification.

best_practices: Supply current, approved product materials and identify every document or image intended for upload.
State the learner, desired first result, language, access mode, and any required page count.
Review external transfer, credit use, and final visibility before the workflow creates or publishes a course.
anti_patterns: Do not request unsupported setup details, invented interface screens, or undocumented compatibility claims.
Do not use the course as proof that a learner completed real equipment or safety procedures.
Do not upload agent-discovered files, buy credits, or broaden access without explicit user authorization.

faq.question: What materials can this skill use?
faq.answer: It can use supplied setup guides, manuals, help articles, screenshots, diagrams, images, and explicitly selected local documents.

faq.question: Does it require a PersonWise account?
faq.answer: Yes. The workflow requires browser OAuth, a compatible PersonWise CLI, network access, and enough course credits.

faq.question: Can it create a course without source documents?
faq.answer: Yes, for an open topic request. Evidence-locked or materials-only requests require supplied sources and cannot add unsupported facts.

faq.question: Can it publish a public course?
faq.answer: It can enable link access or submit to Topics when requested and permitted. Topics submission does not mean platform approval.

faq.question: Will it verify real-world product setup?
faq.answer: No. It guides learning and checks understanding, but it cannot perform or certify installation, calibration, safety, or operation.

faq.question: What happens when course generation is interrupted?
faq.answer: The skill reads the saved run and current allowed actions, then resumes or retries without creating duplicate courses.
